items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. The company's results are linked closely to pricing trends in lithium, and while the price of lithium is up about 67% year over year, it is still well below all-time highs.
